description: This plot illustrates how Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio change as the Recent Sequence Ratio (%) increases from 20% to 100%. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 20 to 100, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Perplexity”, uses a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 40% to 100%, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 10%. The orange line with circle markers, representing “Perplexity”, starts at approximately 4.6 at 20% and generally decreases to about 4.35 around 60%, before rising slightly to about 4.37 at 100%. The blue line with circle markers, representing “GPU Mem. Ratio”, starts at approximately 42% at 20% and increases steadily to about 98% at 100%. A dashed red line at approximately 60% on the right y-axis represents “Full Cache PPL”, and a dashed blue line at approximately 98% on the right y-axis represents “Full Cache GPU Mem.”.
